method.cases_tracked: Open foreclosure cases scraped from the Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach clerk and recorder systems, deduplicated by case number.
method.median_judgment: Median final-judgment amount across cases where the judgment is recorded.
method.sales_next_60: Count of scheduled foreclosure sale dates falling within 60 days of the build date.
method.investor_notes: Open mortgages recorded to LLC borrowers by private/hard-money lenders in the $75k-$5M band, from the Broward recorder mortgage index.
